items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: through Charley Johnson, I had a chance to meet men like Lucky Roberts.

ctx.x: And that's how the show got its name. Was the Chocolate Kiddies. You see, because there was a little kitty on there -- a couple of kiddies on there, brown skinned, dancing. And Lyons said, "That's the name of the show, 'Chocolate Kiddies'". And that quick, it was 'Chocolate Kiddies". Anyhow, when this was over, so now, they brought me because I was supposed to be the captain of the whole thing because I conducted them through the pit, went through with that alright, and then the band turned out to be the greatest…

person anyhow. Anyhow, so then we went out. Now we went to -- right away the Germans said, "Well we must take you first to a bawdy house." We went to this bawdy house. But here's what I didn't need. I'd been always respected by Lyons and all of them and I had my wife with me, so, as well as I wanted to do something in that bawdy house, I didn't. Because I wanted to keep my respect up. And I was almost slobbering at the mouth, but I still kept my respect. I said, "Oh, no, I wouldn't do it. I brought my wife all…
